title: Remove dead code, unused imports, resolved TODOs
objective: Clean up dead code, unused imports, resolved TODOs, and remaining pytest.skip() stubs that have been implemented.
scope: Remove pytest.skip() stubs that are now implemented
deliverables: Clean codebase with no dead code or resolved TODOs
acceptance_criteria: No pytest.skip() stubs remain for implemented features
risks: A grep-driven cleanup pass can accidentally remove intentionally deferred TODOs or runtime-protection skips that still document real limitations.
Removing unused helpers or scaffold leftovers late in the sprint can break tests that still rely on those fixtures indirectly.
completion_notes: Removed the Phase 6 scaffold skips and documented that the only remaining cleanup markers are one intentional Plan B TODO in taichi_printer.py plus the paired placeholder-guard assertions in test_emission_verification.py.
